title: Dubai AI & KHDA Smart School Finder
summary: Dubai's school-finder pilot provides natural-language searches using KHDA school data. The reported benefit is easier information retrieval, not measured educational improvement.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Dubai's school-finder pilot provides natural-language searches using KHDA school data. The reported benefit is easier information retrieval, not measured educational improvement. Initial school-finder pilot. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Help parents find suitable schools through current, searchable information.
system: Dubai AI and KHDA Smart School Finder

ratings.reason: The pilot provides natural-language search across current school data, which the source describes as saving parents time. Better school or educational outcomes are not established.
Better educational planning is intended; no agency-level result is reported.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 11: Dubai AI & KHDA Smart School Finder

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Integration with the intended government service channels

headline: Dubai's Smart School Finder answers parents' questions

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
